calculations.name: CAGR (%)
calculations.description: Compound Annual Growth Rate computed from Total Premium Paid to Maturity Amount over Tenure (Years).

expressions.dax:
VAR InitialValue = SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Total Premium Paid])
 VAR FinalValue = SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Maturity Amount])
 VAR Years = MAX('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Tenure (Years)])

 RETURN
 IF(InitialValue>0 && Years>0,
 (POWER(DIVIDE(FinalValue,InitialValue,0), 1/Years)-1),BLANK())

calculations.name: Annual Amount Growth
calculations.description: Profit / Gain divided by tenure (years) — average annual amount growth.

calculations.name: Annual ROI
calculations.description: Annual Amount Growth divided by Total Annual Premium (returns as ratio).

expressions.dax: DIVIDE([Annual Amount Growth], SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Total Annual Premium]))

calculations.name: Annual Growth Rate Fixed
calculations.description: Annual Amount Growth divided by Total Annual Premium (fixed-divide with zero-handling).

expressions.dax: DIVIDE([Annual Amount Growth],SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Total Annual Premium]),0)

calculations.name: % Premium Paid
calculations.description: Share of total premium that has been paid: Total Premium Paid / Total Premium Amount.

calculations.name: % Premium Payable
calculations.description: Share of total premium that is payable: Total Premium Payable / Total Premium Amount.

technical_summary:
Executive summary — Tru Secure CreDebit Dashboard

Purpose
- Provide a concise description of the business intelligence capability delivered by the Tru Secure CreDebit dashboard and how it supports operational and strategic decision-making for insurance product, sales and finance stakeholders.
- Summarizes the KPIs, insights and decision workflows enabled by the data model and visualizations assembled from policy, customer, agent and regional master data.

Data scope and structure (business view)
- Central policy ledger: a consolidated policy-level dataset captures policy identifiers, start/purchase dates, tenure, premiums (annual and total), amounts paid, payable balances, sum assured / coverage and maturity values.
- Customer and sales dimensions: customer master (age, gender, occupation, smoker status, state), agent roster (agent code, name, state), and hierarchical regional/zonal ownership enable roll-ups by sales geography and ownership.
- Product taxonomy: policy type and protection plan lookups support product-level grouping and comparison.
- Time context: date attributes (purchase, start, tenure anniversary) allow year/quarter/month trend analysis and tenure‑based segmentation (notably 5–20 year cohorts).

Key KPIs and financial metrics tracked
- Premium metrics: Total Annual Premium, Total Premium Amount, Total Premium Paid, Total Premium Payable — core measures for revenue recognition, collection and cash flow monitoring.
- Underwriting expense: aggregate underwriting costs as a control on product profitability and expense benchmarking.
- Conversion/collection ratios: % Premium Paid and % Premium Payable — measures of collection effectiveness and outstanding exposure.
- Profitability / returns: Profit/Gain, Maturity Amount and derived performance metrics including Annual Amount Growth, Annual ROI and an overall growth indicator (CAGR) to measure returns over policy tenures.
- Loan-related exposure: loan eligibility and allowed loan amounts (policy-level) for contingent liabilities and balance-sheet planning.

Primary insights the report delivers
- Revenue and collections health: roll-up and drill-through views of premiums (by product, agent, state, occupation, region, and time) show where premium inflows are strong or lagging and where receivables are concentrated.
- Product profitability and return dynamics: comparison of Total Premiums, Maturity Amounts and derived ROI/CAGR across products and tenures highlights product lines that deliver stronger or weaker returns to customers and the business.
- Geographic and channel performance: hierarchical reporting by zonal → regional → agent exposes sales pockets, high-performing agents and underperforming territories enabling targeted sales management.
- Customer segmentation effects: occupation, age and smoker status can be cross-referenced with premium, collections and maturity outcomes to inform underwriting, pricing and retention strategies.
- Tenure-driven behavior: pages focused on 5–20 year cohorts and tenure date analysis reveal long-term liability patterns, expected maturities and timing of cash flows.
- Underwriting cost control: monitoring of underwriting expense against premium revenue provides early signals for pricing adjustments or process improvements.

Report pages and business use cases
- Summary: high-level KPI cards and a detailed policy-level table for rapid executive review and ad-hoc reconciliation.
  Use cases: executive reporting, portfolio audits, single‑view policy lookups.
- Insurance Overview: product and channel visualizations (pie/donut/treemap/bar/area) showing total annual premium by policy type, plan, agent, state and year.
  Use cases: product performance benchmarking, go-to-market prioritization.
- Investment Amount vs Maturity Amount: comparative trend and combo charts of invested premiums, projected maturity values and annualized ROI.
  Use cases: product design reviews, competitive positioning and customer value communication.
- Annual Premium vs Protection Value: time-series analysis aligned to tenure showing premium flows, sum assured and ROI trends.
  Use cases: capital planning, reserves and risk exposure analysis.
- Premium Analysis (5–20 Years): focused KPIs and trend charts for medium-to-long-tenure policies, including collection ratios.
  Use cases: long-term reserve forecasting, maturity liability scheduling and retention strategies.
- Sales Hierarchy: pivot / hierarchical roll-up by zonal/regional/agent with configurable filters to support compensation, territory planning and performance management.
  Use cases: incentive calibration, territory rebalancing, coach and remediate underperforming agents.

Filtering and exploratory capability
- Users can slice and drill across policy type, protection plan, agent, year, state, occupation and tenure buckets to isolate issues or opportunities and to validate hypotheses during executive reviews or operational stand-ups.

How this supports decision-making
- Operational decisions: identifies collection shortfalls and high-exposure accounts, enabling prioritized collection campaigns, targeted retention offers, and focused underwriting reviews.
- Sales and distribution: reveals high-value agents, product-channel fit and geographic opportunities to guide resource allocation, training and incentive programs.
- Product strategy and pricing: informs profitability analysis and ROI comparisons across products and tenures to support pricing updates, re‑design of product features, and marketing prioritization.
- Financial planning: provides inputs for cash flow forecasting, maturity liability scheduling and capital/reserve planning based on aggregated premium, payable and maturity timelines.
- Risk and compliance: surfaces concentrations (geographic, agent or product) and underwriting expense trends for governance reviews.

Data preparation and quality assurance (business summary)
- Source records from master and transactional feeds were harmonized into a single policy-centric view and linked to customer, agent and managerial hierarchies to enable consistent roll-ups and ownership attribution.
- Regional and state mappings were normalized so reporting reliably reflects territory coverage and manager responsibility.
- Key numeric fields required for financial KPIs (premiums, maturity, underwriting expense, profit/gain, tenure) are surfaced to analytical measures and ratios; the model supports year/tenure comparisons and cohort analysis.

Business value and strategic contribution
- Consolidates critical policy, customer and sales information into a single decision workspace for senior management, finance, product and distribution leads.
- Reduces time-to-insight for revenue, collection and profitability questions and makes it practical to run targeted operational interventions at agent, regional and product levels.
- Strengthens evidence-based product and pricing decisions by exposing lifetime returns and cost dynamics across the portfolio.
- Improves transparency for capital planning and risk oversight through tenure-aware maturity and exposure visualizations.

Next-step recommendations (business-oriented)
- Adopt the dashboard as a regular input for monthly commercial reviews (sales, product and finance) and embed selected KPI cards into executive scorecards.
- Use agent/regional views to design targeted coaching and collection interventions in the top decile of underperforming territories.
- Validate and operationalize thresholds for % Premium Paid and underwriting expense as triggers for remediation or pricing reviews.
- Expand loan exposure reporting and include scenario projections for concentrated maturity periods to support capital planning.

Conclusion
This dashboard transforms disparate policy, customer and sales data into a structured, KPI-driven analytics capability that supports both tactical interventions (collections, sales coaching) and strategic decisions (product profitability, pricing and capital planning). It provides the evidence base required to optimize distribution, safeguard margins and plan for future liabilities.

kpi_lineage.description: Compound Annual Growth Rate computed from Total Premium Paid to Maturity Amount over Tenure (Years).
kpi_lineage.formula:
VAR InitialValue = SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Total Premium Paid])
 VAR FinalValue = SUM('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Maturity Amount])
 VAR Years = MAX('FCT Insurance_Policy_Table'[Tenure (Years)])

 RETURN
 IF(InitialValue>0 && Years>0,
 (POWER(DIVIDE(FinalValue,InitialValue,0), 1/Years)-1),BLANK())
